in_sanskrit.name: प्राग्न्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: प्राग् (before) + ग्न्य (to know, to understand) + आ (towards) = प्राग्न्या (Pragnya) = One who knows beforehand, Intelligent, Wise

in_hindi.name: प्राग्न्या
in_hindi.meaning: प्रागतिक ज्ञान, प्राकृतिक ज्ञान, प्राकृतिक विज्ञान
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रागतिक (beforehand) + ज्ञान (knowledge) = प्रागतिक ज्ञान (Pragtic Jnana) = Previous Knowledge, Foreknowledge, Ancient Knowledge, Ancient Wisdom प्राकृतिक (natural) + ज्ञान (knowledge) = प्राकृतिक ज्ञान (Prakritic Jnana) = Natural Knowledge, Basic Knowledge, Innate Knowledge, Instinctive Knowledge प्राकृतिक (natural) + विज्ञान (science) = प्राकृतिक विज्ञान (Prakritic Vijnana) = Natural Science, Basic Science, Instinctive Science, Innate Science

in_tamil.name: பிராக்ன்யா
in_tamil.long_meaning: பிற (before) + க் (क) + ன் (ந்) + யா (She) = பிராக்ன்யா (Pragnya) = She who knows beforehand, Intelligent, Wise

in_telugu.name: ప్రాగ్న్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: ప్రధానం (beforehand) + జ్ఞానము (knowledge) = ప్రధానం జ్ఞానము (Pradhanam Jnana) = Previous Knowledge, Foreknowledge, Ancient Knowledge, Ancient Wisdom

in_marathi.name: Pragnya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pragnya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who has understanding, intelligence, and knowledge

in_bengali.name: Pragnya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wisdom, Understanding
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pragnya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। She who has understanding, intelligence, and knowledge
